name: Performance Insight – Cookieless Analytics & SEO for WooCommerce
author: nayan4321

sections.description:
See what your WooCommerce store’s visitors do — and what turns them into orders — without Google Analytics, cookies or a consent banner.

Performance Insight lives right inside your WooCommerce menu, next to Orders and Products. Install it, activate it, and your store stats start counting with the next visit. No account, no tracking code, no setup.

Answers in one screen

  • How many people visited today, and how many of them bought?
  • Which products get views but no sales?
  • Where do your buyers come from — Google, Instagram, ads, email or ChatGPT?
  • Which coupons bring sales, and which ones nobody uses?
  • What is out of stock or running low — and is a sold-out product still getting visitors?
  • Which pages and products have SEO problems, and what exactly to fix?

WooCommerce analytics, free

  • Dashboard — visitors, page views, visits, bounce rate, time per visit, orders, sales and conversion rate, compared with the period before.
  • Real-time visitors — who is on your store in the last 30 minutes and what they are looking at.
  • Store sales funnel — product views → added to cart → checkout → orders, so you see where shoppers drop off.
  • Best-selling products — the top 100 products with visitors, orders, units, sales and conversion (physical, digital and subscription products).
  • Traffic sources — search engines, social networks, AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude…), other websites and UTM campaigns, with orders and sales per channel from WooCommerce order attribution.
  • Stock tracking — live stock for every product and variation, low-stock and out-of-stock alerts, days of stock left at the current sales pace, sold-out products that still get visitors, and a direct Edit link for each one. Optional: hide sold-out products from the shop automatically and show them again when they are back in stock, plus a daily stock alert email.
  • Coupons report — sales and discount per code, new vs returning customers, average order with vs without a coupon, and coupons nobody used.
  • Visitors — countries, devices, browsers, operating systems, screen sizes and languages.
  • Pages & posts — most visited pages, entry and exit pages, site search terms and 404 pages not found.
  • SEO score for every page, post and product — weakest first, with a checklist (title, meta description, text length, image alt text, headings, links, photos, reviews, SKU, stock). Works with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress and Elementor.
  • A detail screen for every page and product — visitors per day, sources, mobile vs desktop, add-to-carts, sales and its SEO problems.
  • Any period — today, yesterday, 7 or 30 days, this or last month, this year or custom dates.
  • CSV export of every report.

Privacy friendly, GDPR friendly

  • No cookies and no IP addresses stored. A visitor is counted once per day with a one-way code that changes every day.
  • Country comes from the browser’s time zone — no IP lookup, no outside service.
  • Raw page views are kept for 4 days only; after that only daily totals remain.
  • Your own staff (administrators, shop managers — you choose) are not counted, bots are filtered and “Do Not Track” is respected.
  • Everything stays in your own WordPress database. This plugin sends no data anywhere.

Light and fast

Your pages are not changed. A tiny script (about 1 KB) sends one small request after the page has loaded. No jQuery, no external scripts, no slowdown.

Want profit, ads and AI advice too? Laghavi Ads Hub (paid)

Laghavi Ads Hub is a separate paid service by Laghavi Digital. With a plan you receive the Performance Insight Pro add-on, which connects your store to your Hub dashboard:

  • Profit per product after ad spend, and stock vs ads.
  • Your store next to your ads on Meta, Google, TikTok and more — which ads really sell.
  • Abandoned carts, customer value and segments.
  • AI review of each product page and an AI action plan.

This free plugin is complete on its own and never sends data. Only the Pro add-on, installed separately, connects to Laghavi Ads Hub. Learn more at https://laghavi.site/performance-insight/
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress go to Plugins → Add New, search for “Performance Insight WooCommerce analytics” and click Install Now, then Activate. (WooCommerce must be active.)
  2. Open WooCommerce → Performance Insight.
  3. That’s it — counting starts with the next visit.
sections.faq:
Where do I find the reports?

In WooCommerce → Performance Insight. All screens (Visitors, Sources, Pages & posts, Products, Coupons, Stock, SEO scores, Settings) are in the tab bar at the top of the page.

Is this a Google Analytics alternative for WooCommerce?

For most store owners, yes: visitors, sources, the sales funnel, products, coupons and conversion rate in one simple screen inside WordPress — without cookies, consent banners or a Google account. If you also use Google Analytics, both can run side by side.

Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. Orders, sales, products, the funnel and coupons come from WooCommerce, so WordPress asks for WooCommerce to be active first.

Can I see traffic from ChatGPT and other AI assistants?

Yes. When someone clicks a link to your store inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude or similar, the visit is counted under AI assistants with the assistant’s name — and you see the orders it brought.

Does it slow my site down?

No. Pages are not changed. A tiny script (about 1 KB) sends one small request after the page has loaded, and one more with the time spent when the visitor leaves.

Do I need a cookie banner for this plugin?

The plugin sets no cookies and stores no IP addresses. Check your local law and your own privacy policy, but this plugin is built to need no consent for counting.

Is my data sent anywhere?

No. Everything stays in your WordPress database. Only the separate Performance Insight Pro add-on (part of a paid Laghavi Ads Hub plan) sends data, and only after you connect it.

Will numbers match Google Analytics?

Not exactly. Every analytics tool counts a little differently (ad blockers, bots, consent banners, staff visits). Use the numbers to compare your own pages, products and periods with each other.

How long is data kept?

Daily totals are kept as long as you choose in Settings (default 400 days). Raw page views are kept for 4 days only.

Does it work with HPOS, Elementor and SEO plugins?

Yes — WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage, Elementor pages and Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO and SEOPress are supported.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

By default all its tables and settings are removed. You can switch that off in Settings.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • The reports now live inside the WooCommerce menu (WooCommerce → Performance Insight), next to Orders and Products. All screens are in the tab bar at the top; old links keep working.
  • The Pro page is now WooCommerce → Insight Pro.
  • New Stock screen: live stock for every product and variation, low-stock and out-of-stock alerts, days of stock left at the current sales pace, visitors to sold-out products, and an Edit link for each product. CSV export.
  • Optional: hide products from the shop and search automatically while they are sold out, and show them again when they are back in stock (off by default; products you hid yourself are never touched).
  • Optional daily stock alert email.
  • Stock alerts on the Dashboard and a count on the Stock tab.
  • A review request for administrators after 3 days of use. Closing it or “Maybe later” reminds again after 24 hours; “I already did” stops it for good.
  • Clearer plugin description and FAQ.

1.2.0

  • Any period (today, yesterday, 7 / 30 days, this / last month, this year, custom dates) on every report, compared with the period before.
  • Dashboard: visits, bounce rate, time per visit and pages per visit; visitors per day; real-time visitors; top countries.
  • New Visitors screen: countries (from the browser time zone, no IP lookup), devices, browsers, operating systems, screen sizes, languages and visits per day.
  • New Traffic sources screen: search engines, social networks, AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude…), websites, campaigns and source / medium, with orders and sales per channel.
  • Pages & posts: top 100, entry pages, exit pages, site search terms and pages not found (404).
  • Products: store funnel (product views → cart → checkout → orders) and the top 100 products.
  • CSV export of every report.
  • Settings: exclude IP addresses; choose which roles can see the reports.

1.1.2

  • For the Pro add-on’s conversion reports: orders also carry the device type, the landing page path and which ad click IDs the visit had (names only), from WooCommerce’s own order attribution. Add-to-cart events report the device type to add-ons.

1.1.1

  • Fix: variable products whose variations are all virtual or downloadable now show as Digital, not Physical.
  • Subscription products made with YITH, SUMO, WP Swings or WebToffee subscriptions are now recognised as Subscriptions.
  • New lgpi_product_kind filter to correct a product’s kind.

1.1.0

  • New: a detail screen for every page, post and product — visitors per day, sources, devices, sales and its SEO problem list.
  • New: richer Coupons screen — new vs returning customers, top countries, discount % of sales, average order with vs without a coupon, and unused coupons.
  • The visit counter also sends the visitor’s time zone (for visits by country in add-ons) and notes checkout-page visits. Still no cookies and no personal data.
  • New lgpi_hit action for add-ons.

1.0.0

  • First release.
